title: VibeServe: Can AI Agents Build Bespoke LLM Serving Systems?
abstract: arXiv:2605.06068v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: For years, we have built LLM serving systems like any other critical infrastructure, with a single general-purpose stack hand-tuned over many engineer-years to support every model and workload. In this paper, we take the opposite bet and let coding agents automatically synthesize bespoke serving systems for different usage scenarios. We propose VibeServe, the first agentic loop that generates entire LLM serving stacks end-to-end. VibeServe uses an outer loop to plan and track the search over system designs, and an inner loop to implement candidates, check correctness, and measure performance on the target benchmark. In standard serving settings, VibeServe matches vLLM and SGLang on Llama-3.1-8B, and delivers 2.3x the goodput of a tuned SGLang for a 397B MoE model on four AMD MI300As. In five non-standard scenarios, VibeServe outperforms existing systems by exploiting opportunities that generic systems miss, spanning non-standard mode

translated_title: VibeServe：AI智能体能否构建定制的LLM服务系统？
translated_abstract: 多年来，我们构建LLM服务系统的方式与其他关键基础设施一样：使用一个经过多年工程师手动调优的单一通用技术栈来支持所有模型和工作负载。在本文中，我们采取了相反的思路，让编码智能体自动为不同的使用场景合成定制化的服务系统。我们提出了VibeServe，这是首个能够端到端生成完整LLM服务技术栈的智能体循环框架。VibeServe使用外层循环来规划和跟踪系统设计空间的搜索，使用内层循环来实现候选方案、检查正确性并在目标基准上测量性能。在标准服务设置中，VibeServe在Llama-3.1-8B上与vLLM和SGLang表现相当，并且在四块AMD MI300A上运行397B MoE模型时，提供了经过调优的SGLang 2.3倍的有效吞吐量（goodput）。在五个非标准场景中，VibeServe通过利用通用系统所忽视的机会，超越了现有系统，涵盖非标准模……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: VibeServe是首个利用AI编码智能体通过外层规划与内层实现的双层循环，自动端到端生成定制化LLM服务系统的框架，在标准场景下媲美vLLM和SGLang，在非标准场景下则通过利用通用系统忽视的优化机会实现显著超越（最高达2.3倍有效吞吐量提升）。
en_tdlr: VibeServe is the first agentic loop framework that automatically synthesizes bespoke LLM serving stacks end-to-end via an outer planning loop and an inner implementation loop, matching vLLM and SGLang in standard settings while outperforming existing systems in non-standard scenarios by exploiting opportunities that generic systems miss.
